add one F next to the distal ring N
proposals.hypothesis: Two directions raised f in the DFT data. Pyrazine-side substitution on the D05 core kept f at or above 1 (D19 0.86, D14 0.97; the pyrazine-F analog reached f 1.24). The tetra-aza core reached margin 0.18 with f 1.07. Ring N atoms away from the carbonyls lifted margin by about 0.19 V in D10 versus D21, with no CO2 detachment. Quinone-ring halogens cut f (D05 to F2 and Cl2 variants: f 0.65-0.77), so this proposal avoids them. The aza-phenazinedione keeps the N,N pocket beside the carbonyls (K123/K124 report strong binding with log K of 9-11), so binding stays near -27 kcal/mol. The distal aza plus F pair should add margin of 0.15 V or more. The difluoro-phenazine analog had f 1.19 and margin -0.018. The extra N should supply the missing margin, and one F rather than two limits the halogen-count f penalty (D18, D13). Whether f can approach 2 is untested; DFT will decide. Avoids CN, amino and OH, which detached or gave f below -1.
